title: ENT-A pre-specified analysis script: GA episodes, missed combination opportunities, consultation timeliness and counterfactual planner (synthetic test data only)
description: Analysis code written before data extraction for a retrospective cleft-care cohort (Pranangklao Hospital). Includes a synthetic test-data generator and 8 edge-case tests. No patient data are included or used; the output shown is from synthetic test data and is not study evidence. The combinability matrix and timing assumptions in the script are drafts awaiting multidisciplinary-team sign-off.
